WelcomePage.metaDescription: Your starting point at RokitG: connect Discord, explore Courses on Whop, and meet the community.
WelcomePage.intro: Learn, share, and grow with people on the same path. Your next step starts inside the community.
WelcomePage.heroNote: Free Community or Social Capital: start here.
WelcomePage.hostMessage: This space is yours too. Come with curiosity, share what you learn, and ask when something doesn't click.
WelcomePage.hostSignature: One step at a time. — Rokit
WelcomePage.stepsSectionTitle: Three steps to feel at home.
WelcomePage.stepsSectionSubtitle: Start with Discord. Everything else, at your own pace.
WelcomePage.discordBody: Connect your account from Whop to enter the server and access the channels included in your plan.
WelcomePage.discordAlreadyConnected: Already connected? Open Discord on Whop
WelcomePage.step1Body: Log in with the account you used to join.
WelcomePage.step2Body: Select the Discord account you want to use.
WelcomePage.step3Body: Tap «Claim Access» and follow the link to the server.
WelcomePage.connectionNote: Whop handles linking your plan to Discord.
WelcomePage.coursesBody: Open the courses app on Whop, explore what's available for your access, and pick a lesson to start.
WelcomePage.coursesListAriaLabel: A sample of the courses on Whop
WelcomePage.helloBody: Once you're in, say hi and tell us what brings you here. No need for a big introduction.
WelcomePage.icebreakerExample: Hey! I'm ___, I'm from ___, and I joined because I want to learn about ___. Glad to be here!
WelcomePage.encouragement: You can start with a question. Everyone's had a first one.
WelcomePage.helpBody: Save this page. You can always come back to these first steps.
WelcomePage.faq1Q: Does this apply to my plan?
WelcomePage.faq1A: Yes. Both Free Community and Social Capital start here. You'll find the content and channels available for your access on Whop and Discord.
WelcomePage.faq2Q: I'm on Discord but don't see my channels.
WelcomePage.faq2A: Check that you're using the same Whop account you joined with and the Discord account you connected. <link>Go back to Discord on Whop</link> to review your access.
WelcomePage.faq3Q: Where do I find the courses?
WelcomePage.faq3A: They're in the RokitG Courses app on Whop. <link>Open it here</link> and log in with your usual account.
